propositions: Author a new Pass-1 overlay prompt file for concurrency races that follows the lockset-first quartet rubric: concurrency-model gate, unlocked-twin/sibling-accessor check, all four race quartet elements (shared mutable resource, concurrent executors, interleaving window, concrete harm), and disposition-aware guard-suppression rules.
The prompt must defer TOCTOU findings to the security overlay and load-shaped concurrency findings to the performance overlay, and must instruct that empty findings are expected.
The prompt file must include required frontmatter keys (outputs, execution_mode, category, dimension, langfuse_prompt) matching the pattern of code-review-security.md and code-review-performance.md.
This story delivers the prompt document only in an inert state; all wiring for reachability (registry entry, routing, dispatch) is owned by the dependent registration story errable-tricksome-ape.
